examples.english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for the Kingdom of God, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body.
So the servants of king Ezekias came to Esaias.

examples.english: And he went in to Rachel; and he loved Rachel more than Lea; and he served him seven other years.
